What to look for: dxc_1_6_2112 (CE's oldest DXC) rejects the profile outright with
"error: invalid profile lib_6_8" -- lib_6_8 / Work Graphs did not exist yet, so this pane is
not evidence the bug is absent, only that the feature is unavailable there. dxc_trunk is the
one that answers the question: it should compile this node shader, but instead exits 139
(SIGSEGV) with no diagnostic at all. That crash, not any printed message, is the reported
missing-type-annotation defect (#5357) still reproducing on the current compiler.
